name: nvk
rc_text:
# NVK test only - NVK is never the system Vulkan driver (ro.hardware.vulkan stays intel). Native tree only.
# Prerequisite: persist.vendor.gb.nouveau=1 (gb_power leaves the dGPU on nouveau), base attached.
service gb_nvk_probe /system/bin/sh -c "/vendor/bin/nvk_probe -n 200 -o /data/vendor/nvk/probe.ppm > /data/vendor/nvk/probe.txt 2>&1; echo nvk_probe exit=$$? >> /data/vendor/nvk/probe.txt"
    user root
    group root graphics
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    stdio_to_kmsg
    oneshot
    disabled

on post-fs-data
    mkdir /data/vendor/nvk 0775 root shell

on property:vendor.gb.nvk_probe=1
    setprop vendor.gb.nvk_probe 0
    start gb_nvk_probe
